MercaTUM

On-demand LLM marketplace prototype with BSV micropayments and MCP integration for external AI agents.

I built MercaTUM at the TUM Blockchain & AI Hackathon: an on-demand LLM marketplace prototype with BSV micropayments and MCP integration for external AI agents.

The project was awarded 3rd place in BSV Association’s DeFi Rails for Agentic Payments track.

View the source code on GitHub.

Highlights
  • Built at the TUM Blockchain & AI Hackathon.
  • Awarded 3rd place in BSV Association’s DeFi Rails for Agentic Payments track.
